propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has written the indexing jobs and schema changes for the document and comment indexes on a document collaboration company's search indexing pipeline team since 2022, each change on a merge request in her name, and proved every change on the replay corpus before merge with the replay result attached.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the merge requests document the changes and the replay results.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer, with the rebuild go-ahead staying with the pipeline lead, and answered the support engineers' indexing delay questions in the pipeline support channel with the referral split marked.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the rebuild checklist and the reference call document the rebuilds, the go-ahead boundary and the support work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the merge requests document the boundary notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the changes, the replay results, the rebuilds, the support work and the boundary notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the go-ahead boundary as documented: rebuild checklists by the candidate, rebuild go-ahead by the pipeline lead; the packet makes no judgement.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the repository references of the nine rebuild checklists to confirm the go-ahead field.
